install: set -euo pipefail; PW_DIR="$HOME/.local/playwright"; mkdir -p "$PW_DIR"; if [ ! -d "$PW_DIR/node_modules/playwright" ]; then npm --prefix "$PW_DIR" install --no-audit --no-fund playwright; fi; "$PW_DIR/node_modules/.bin/playwright" install chromium; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; LINE='export NODE_PATH="$HOME/.local/playwright/node_modules${NODE_PATH:+:$NODE_PATH}"'; grep -qxF "$LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
